nodes.description: Address of the contract owner stored in Ownable; written in constructors and transferOwnership.
Total token supply tracked by StandardToken; set by BCC constructor and reduced by burn.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance, mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Constant initial supply of 1e9 * 10^18 assigned to the deployer in the BCC constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership and the onlyOwner check.
Owner-only function that replaces the owner address.
ERC20 transfer that debits msg.sender and credits _to using SafeMath.
ERC20 transferFrom that spends allowance from _from and moves balances.
Sets a raw allowance for a spender on behalf of msg.sender.
Additively increases the caller's allowance to a spender.
Subtractively decreases the caller's allowance to a spender, flooring at zero.
Destroys tokens from the caller's balance and reduces totalSupply.
Constructor that mints the initialSupply to msg.sender and sets totalSupply.
View function returning the balance of a given address.
View function returning the remaining allowance for an owner/spender pair.
Constructor that assigns ownership to msg.sender.
Checked addition library routine using assert for overflow.
Checked subtraction library routine using assert for underflow.
Checked multiplication library routine using assert.
Unchecked division library routine.
Arithmetic balance updates in transfer (sub on sender, add on recipient).
Arithmetic balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
Arithmetic burn accounting: balance sub and totalSupply sub.
Arithmetic allowance increment in increaseApproval.
Arithmetic allowance decrement in decreaseApproval.

edges.reason: transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to read and spend the allowance.
approve stores the allowance under allowed[msg.sender].
increaseApproval updates allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseApproval updates allowed[msg.sender][spender] and caches it in oldValue.
burn debits balances[msg.sender] and caches it as burner.
Ownable constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting privileged control.
BCC constructor credits the whole initialSupply to msg.sender.
Recipient parameter feeds the balance credit in transfer.
Amount parameter feeds the SafeMath sub/add in transfer.
Source parameter feeds balance lookup in transferFrom.
Destination parameter feeds balance credit in transferFrom.
Amount parameter feeds balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Address parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
Value parameter becomes the stored allowance in approve.
Owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in increaseApproval.
Added value parameter feeds the allowance increment.
Spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in decreaseApproval.
Subtracted value parameter drives the branch and the subtraction.
Value parameter is the amount subtracted from balance and totalSupply in burn.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner address.
oldValue local caches the allowance before conditional subtraction.
burner local caches msg.sender for the balance debit and events.
_allowance local caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] before spending.
transfer performs balance arithmetic whose overflow/underflow behaviour depends on SafeMath.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance arithmetic vulnerable to unchecked math.
burn subtracts from balance and totalSupply arithmetic.
increaseApproval adds to the allowance, an overflow-prone operation.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowance, an underflow-prone operation.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
burn reduces totalSupply.
BCC constructor initialises totalSupply with initialSupply.
BCC constructor writes the full supply into balances[msg.sender].
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on the stored owner address.
transferFrom decreases the stored allowance in allowed.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
initialSupply constant seeds totalSupply inside the BCC constructor.
transfer calls SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
burn calls SafeMath.sub for balance and totalSupply.
